How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was really not good! Courses which were on the list were suddently not a part of the courses list during registration which made it difficult to be aware of possible courses you can get approved. More over its very difficult to find courses which is not overlapping - and this is the students own responsibilliy making it almost nessecary to skip on course to be able to attend other classes.
